exposure: vaginal birth after previous caesarean section
cohort: 135 pregnant patients aged 16-45 years with singleton pregnancies and a gestational age of >= 28 weeks, admitted for a second vaginal birth after a previous caesarean section.
finding: The frequency of uterine rupture after vaginal birth in patients with a previous caesarean section was 1.48%.
mod_finding: The study found that uterine rupture occurred in 1.48% of patients undergoing vaginal birth after a previous caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Data collected from January 2019 to February 2020
gest_age: >= 28 weeks (inclusion criteria), mean 39.21+1.98 weeks at delivery
